evidence.ACL: Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: There is mild thickening of the proximal medial collateral ligament
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Oblique tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending into the tibial meniscal surface.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Degenerative radial tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

evidence.Lateral OA: focal severe chondrosis involving the weightbearing zone and posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle with focal deep cartilage defect
evidence.PF OA: There is a mild superficial chondral disease involving the patellofemoral joint.
evidence.Effusion: There is a mild joint effusion
evidence.Baker's: There is a low volume Baker's cyst.
